body.title: Ready to Build Something Exceptional?
body.description: Whether you're launching a new website, building an AI-powered platform, modernising your ecommerce experience or creating a custom business application, our team is ready to help you turn ambitious ideas into measurable business results.

faqs.question: Why choose IGENTX over other web development companies?
faqs.answer: IGENXT combines AI-accelerated delivery with enterprise-grade engineering practices. Unlike template agencies, we build custom solutions on modern stacks like Next.js and React, optimised for performance, SEO and scalability from day one. Our team has deep UAE market experience with multilingual delivery, and we measure success by business outcomes: leads, conversions and operational efficiency, not just launch dates. You work with one team from strategy through launch and ongoing growth.

faqs.question: What industries do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: We serve retail, ecommerce, healthcare, education, childcare, real estate, professional services and technology companies. Our UAE experience spans bilingual websites, local SEO, payment integrations and compliance-aware delivery. We also build vertical SaaS products like DaycareMate for early childhood education. Whether you need a marketing website, custom application or AI integration, we tailor the approach to your industry's specific workflows, regulations and customer expectations.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups and enterprises?
faqs.answer: Yes. For startups, we focus on fast MVP delivery, clear scope and foundations that scale. For enterprises, we emphasise architecture, security, integrations and phased rollouts. Our process adapts to your team size, budget and timeline, from a single landing page to multi-language platforms with headless CMS, ecommerce and AI automation. Contact us for a scoped proposal based on your goals.

faqs.question: Why is Next.js better than traditional website builders?
faqs.answer: Next.js delivers server-side rendering and static generation for faster page loads, better Core Web Vitals and stronger SEO than drag-and-drop builders. You get full design freedom, API integrations, multilingual support and enterprise security, without platform lock-in. For UAE businesses competing on Google, performance and technical SEO structure directly impact rankings. Next.js on Vercel also provides global edge delivery, which matters for international and local audiences alike.

faqs.question: How long does website development take?
faqs.answer: Timeline depends on scope: a focused marketing site typically takes 2–4 weeks; larger corporate or ecommerce projects take 4–8 weeks. Factors include page count, integrations, multilingual requirements and content readiness. Our seven-step process includes discovery, strategy, design, development, QA, launch and ongoing growth, with clear milestones at each stage. We provide a realistic timeline after a brief discovery call.

faqs.question: Can you redesign an existing website?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We migrate and redesign existing sites, including WordPress, Shopify and custom builds, to modern architectures without losing SEO equity when planned correctly. A redesign typically improves page speed, mobile experience, conversion paths and search visibility. We audit your current site, preserve valuable content and URLs, and rebuild with performance and accessibility built in from the start.

faqs.question: How does your AI Customer Service Agent work?
faqs.answer: Our AI agent is trained on your website content, documents and FAQs using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It answers visitor questions instantly, captures contact details naturally in chat, and saves enquiries to your admin dashboard. Integration takes one line of code on any website. You control the knowledge base, review conversations and update content as your business evolves. It is deployable for subscribers and designed for accuracy, not generic chatbot responses.

faqs.question: Can the AI answer questions using our website content?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent indexes your pages, PDFs, service lists and uploaded documents. When a visitor asks a question, it retrieves relevant content and generates a grounded response. You can update the knowledge base anytime. This ensures answers reflect your actual offerings, pricing approach and policies, building trust with UAE and international visitors who expect accurate, immediate information.

faqs.question: Is the AI agent multilingual?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent supports multilingual conversations so visitors can get accurate responses in their preferred language. This is valuable for global businesses and UAE teams serving diverse local and international audiences.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: Technical SEO improvements can show indexing and speed gains within weeks. Meaningful ranking improvements for competitive keywords typically take 3–6 months with consistent content and authority building. Local UAE SEO for Dubai and Abu Dhabi may show faster results for location-specific queries. We set realistic expectations, track progress monthly and focus on qualified traffic that converts, not vanity metrics.

faqs.question: Do you provide local SEO for Dubai and the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes. We optimise Google Business Profile, local citations, multilingual landing pages, and location-specific schema markup. UAE local search requires multilingual strategy, mobile-first performance and culturally relevant content. We have experience helping businesses rank for Dubai, Abu Dhabi and emirate-specific queries while supporting international visibility.

faqs.question: How do you improve Core Web Vitals?
faqs.answer: We optimise images, implement lazy loading, minimise JavaScript, use edge hosting on Vercel, and structure pages for fast LCP, low CLS and responsive FID/INP. Every IGENTX project includes performance budgets and Lighthouse testing before launch. For existing sites, we audit bottlenecks and implement targeted fixes, often achieving 90+ performance scores without sacrificing design quality.

faqs.question: Shopify vs BigCommerce: which is right for my business?
faqs.answer: Shopify excels for fast setup, app ecosystem and smaller-to-mid catalogues. BigCommerce suits larger catalogues, B2B features and headless commerce flexibility. We assess your product count, integration needs, customisation requirements and growth plans to recommend the right platform, or a headless approach with Next.js storefront for maximum performance and design freedom.

faqs.question: What is Headless Commerce?
faqs.answer: Headless commerce separates the storefront (frontend) from the commerce engine (backend) via APIs. This enables blazing-fast custom storefronts, omnichannel experiences and design freedom while keeping robust cart, inventory and payment logic. We build headless stores with Shopify, BigCommerce or commercetools paired with Next.js, optimised for Core Web Vitals and conversion.

faqs.question: What is DaycareMate and who is it for?
faqs.answer: DaycareMate is IGENTX's childcare management platform for nurseries, preschools, childcare centres and early learning providers. It covers admissions, attendance, daily care logs, parent communication and billing in one system. Each centre gets a dedicated deployment with white-label branding: your centre name, logo, favicon, and branded invoice PDFs. It is built by the same team behind BloomWave's digital transformation, designed for real centre operations, not generic school admin software.

faqs.question: Do you provide maintenance after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing support packages covering security updates, performance monitoring, content changes, feature iterations and SEO optimisation. Websites and applications need continuous care, including plugin updates, dependency patches and analytics review. We tailor support to your needs, from ad-hoc hours to monthly retainers with SLA response times.

faqs.question: How do you secure websites?
faqs.answer: Security is built into every project: SSL/TLS encryption, secure headers, input validation, dependency auditing and OWASP-aware development practices. For UAE deployments, we follow data protection best practices and can advise on compliance requirements. We also configure automated backups, access controls and monitoring to detect issues before they impact your business.
